# Introduction

This document demonstrates the integration of **T-Lang**, **Quarto**, and **LaTeX**. We use T-Lang to process data and LaTeX to render high-quality mathematical equations and PDF output.

## T-Lang Code Execution

The following T-Lang chunk calculates some basic statistics on the `mtcars` dataset.

```{t}
#| label: stats-calculation
#| echo: true
model = lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data: mtcars)
stats = fit_stats(model)
print(stats)
```

## Mathematical Equations (LaTeX)

We can include complex LaTeX equations seamlessly:

$$
y = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_1 + \beta_2 x_2 + \epsilon
$$

Where:
- $y$ is the `mpg` (Miles per Gallon).
- $x_1$ is the `wt` (Weight).
- $x_2$ is the `hp` (Horsepower).

The estimated coefficients from the T-Lang model are:

```{t}
#| label: show-coefs
#| echo: false
c = coef(model)
print(c)
```

## Conclusion

This PDF was generated entirely within a T-Lang pipeline using Nix to manage all dependencies, including the full TeX Live distribution.
